title: Till Guidance on Where an Upgrade Credit May Be Applied, by Belrose Programme
content:
An upgrade credit issued under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is spent on merchandise. Whether it may also be spent on a protection plan, on workshop work or on a custom commission, whether it may be applied against a financed balance rather than at the till, whether it may be spent alongside a promotional discount, whether anyone other than the customer it was issued to may spend it, and whether it may be taken as money, is fixed programme by programme. The till applies the matrix below.

## Matrix

| Programme | Spendable by another person | Alongside a promotion | On a protection plan | On workshop work | On a custom commission | Against a financed balance | Taken as money |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | no | no | no | no | no | yes | no |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | no | no | no | no | yes | yes | no |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | yes | no |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | no | no | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |

## Reading the matrix

- Only the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme lets a credit be taken as money, and it is also the only programme whose credit may not be applied against a financed balance.
- Only the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee and the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee issue a credit that a person other than the customer it was issued to may spend.
- Workshop work may be paid for with credit under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee, the Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege and the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme only.
- A custom commission may be paid for with credit under every programme except the Belrose Standard Trade-In.
